thread:
Lina: Quick follow-up from the console UX review: charts get visually noisy on narrow dashboards. We should decide behavior for legend, ticks, smoothing, and outlier visuals.
Rafi: Agreed. Main pain is tick density + legend wrapping. On <480px panels ticks overlap labels.
Jo: Proposal: adaptive tick density: `auto | compact | dense`. Auto = heuristics based on pixel width. Add shortcut `g t` to toggle in the viewer.
Maya: Legend pattern: show micro-badges (color + 2-char abbrev) inline, collapse to a single row with a chevron if >3 series. Hover reveals full name. Keeps height low.
Owen: Outlier handling idea: "visual cap" option that fades values exceeding threshold instead of re-scaling Y. Show a tiny capped marker at the capped value so raw extremes are discoverable.
Lina: UX copy: label the control "Outlier threshold (visual cap)" with tooltip "Fades values above threshold; raw values remain in inspect panel".
Rafi: Accessibility: badges need pattern overlays (dots/diagonals) for colorblind users. Also ensure aria-labels include series name + unit.
Jo: Smoothing presets: Off / Gentle (MA3) / Stable (MA7) / "Raw-with-preserve-peaks". Maybe rename "Raw+peaks" for compactness.
Maya: Minor: smoothing tooltip should read: "Reduces noise; may hide short spikes. Use Raw+peaks to keep significant spikes."
Owen: Align Y-axis option: when enabled, show unit once at group header (e.g., "Latency (ms)") and use compact SI ticks `1.2k`/`1.1M`. Full numeric on hover.
Lina: Tick labels: allow toggling between suffix units `ms` after numbers vs unit in axis label only. Which is clearer?
Rafi: I vote unit in axis label only for cleaner tick layout. Screen readers get explicit unit in aria.
Jo: Also add a tiny legend mini-key for dotted vs solid vs faded lines to explain host-level vs aggregate vs capped. Discoverability is low without it.
Maya: Snapshot feature request: let users pin a vertical marker with a short note (like "deploy #123"). Should persist with dashboard share. Keyboard `p` to add marker.
Owen: Dev note: implement cap as a visual transform layer, not data mutation, so alerts and exports still use raw values.
DesignBot: Reminder: update color tokens + add pattern overlays in tokens v2 by EOD Friday.
Lina: I'll mock the compact-legend + auto ticks + capped-outlier states in Figma and post link. Default suggestion: auto ticks, legend collapsed when >3, smoothing Gentle. Posting in #design in 30m.
Rafi: Thanks, Lina. Small :thumbsup:
Jo: Thanks all — will bake keyboard hints into the help overlay.
Maya: Nice work :sparkles:
